get.description:
Probe DB + Redis. 503 on either failure.

Both probes are wrapped individually so the response body indicates
*which* dependency failed — the LB only cares about the status code,
but the body helps oncall.

post.summary: Register a customer with email + password (dev)
post.description: Create a customer account using email + argon2id password + phone. Returns the user id + a JWT pair. **Local-dev convenience added on top of v1.0.0-rc1.** Production deploys still use SMS-OTP per spec (see PRODUCT §17 + PHARMACY §3.2).
Email + argon2id password verify → JWT pair. Returns the same shape as ``/auth/otp/verify``. **Local-dev convenience.**

Up to 4 substitutes (same primary AI + dose, in stock).

The endpoint takes the product *slug*, but the substitute query
needs the product id — fetch the detail (cache hit on a hot
product) and pass id through.

post.description:
Inline path for ≤2 MB images; larger uploads enqueue
``process_image_upload`` (Phase 11 worker) and return 202 with
a job_id. Phase 12 — keeps the common-case inline (Pillow + storage
upload completes in <1 s for storefront images) and only hands off
when the upload is large enough to risk a request timeout.

schema.title: Response Upload Image Api Admin V1 Products  Product Id  Images Post

post.description:
Inline apply for ≤500-row CSVs (current path). Larger uploads
enqueue ``process_product_import`` (Phase 11 worker) and return 202
with an ``import_id``; admin polls
``GET /admin/v1/products/imports/{import_id}`` for progress.

schema.title: Response Import Apply Api Admin V1 Products Import Apply Post

get.description:
Read the Phase 11 progress hash ``v1:import:<import_id>``.

Returns the raw hash fields the worker writes (``status`` /
``processed`` / ``total`` / ``n_create`` / ``n_update`` / ``n_skip``
/ ``errors``). 404 if the key is absent or expired (worker hasn't
started yet, or 24h TTL elapsed).

AdminOrderDetail.title: AdminOrderDetail
AdminOrderDetail.description:
Admin detail view — same shape as customer ``OrderRead`` plus
``user_id`` / ``internal_notes`` / courier info / branch_id.

BatchAdjustRequest.title: BatchAdjustRequest
BatchAdjustRequest.description:
PATCH /admin/v1/inventory/batches/{batch_id}.

``movement_type`` is restricted to manual-correction kinds; sales /
reservations / restocks are handled by other service paths.

BatchReceiveResponse.title: BatchReceiveResponse
BatchReceiveResponse.description:
Wraps ``BatchRead`` with two service-layer flags the admin UI uses
to render warnings / next-step prompts.

* ``is_short_dated`` — expiry within 60 days (PRODUCT §10.5 soft warn).
* ``branch_product_pending_pricing`` — first-receive auto-created the
  ``branch_products`` row at price=0, is_available=False; admin must
  set a price before storefront shows the product.

BulkImportRowError.title: BulkImportRowError
BulkImportRowError.description: One row-level error from CSV/XLSX import dry-run.

CategoryDetail.title: CategoryDetail
CategoryDetail.description: Single category + breadcrumb for the category page header.

CategoryNode.title: CategoryNode
CategoryNode.description: A node in the storefront category tree.

CheckoutQuoteRequest.title: CheckoutQuoteRequest
CheckoutQuoteRequest.description:
POST /api/v1/checkout/quote.

``address_id`` is required for delivery; pickup ignores it.

PlaceOrderAddress.title: PlaceOrderAddress
PlaceOrderAddress.description: Inline address for guests / new addresses at checkout.

ProductRead.title: ProductRead
ProductRead.description: Full product view for admin endpoints.

RefundRequest.title: RefundRequest
RefundRequest.description:
POST /admin/v1/orders/{id}/refund.

``amount`` must be ≤ ``order.total``. Idempotency-Key header
REQUIRED on the route.

RegisterIn.title: RegisterIn
RegisterIn.description:
``POST /api/v1/auth/register`` — email + password + phone.

Production deploys still use SMS-OTP per spec; this is a local-dev
convenience added on top of v1.0.0-rc1.

RegisterOut.title: RegisterOut
RegisterOut.description: Register returns the user's id + the full token pair.

ReorderResponseLine.title: ReorderResponseLine
ReorderResponseLine.description:
One annotated line returned by ``POST /me/orders/{n}/reorder``.

The service adds in-stock items to the current cart and surfaces
the rest with reasons (out_of_stock / price_changed / product_deleted)
so the UI can prompt the customer to remove or substitute.

SearchResultPage.title: SearchResultPage
SearchResultPage.description: Search response. Mirrors :class:`Page` but adds search-only fields.

StorefrontProductCard.title: StorefrontProductCard
StorefrontProductCard.description:
Slim product shape for category / search / suggest lists.

``score`` is populated only by the search endpoint — informational.

StorefrontProductsPage.title: StorefrontProductsPage
StorefrontProductsPage.description: Generic paginated product list (category / symptom / search-without-scoring).
